chunks: Does he not know when the contents of the graves are laid bare
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the resurrection from the graves?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Adiyat, this verse underscores the suddenness of the Hour, contrasting the disbelievers' preoccupation with worldly pursuits against the certainty of bodily resurrection. Shia exegetes, such as Al-Ayyashi and Al-Qummi, emphasize that 'being scattered' (bu'shir) refers to the physical dispersal of bodies, affirming the doctrine of bodily resurrection (al-Ba'th al-Jismani) as a prerequisite for divine recompense.
